movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Use of angika abhinaya hand gestures derived from Kathakali

movement_profile.posture: Tribhanga stance replacing the traditional Kathakali posture

signature_moves.description: A three-bend posture replacing Kathakali's rigid stance for fluidity
signature_moves.name: Tribhanga Pose

instruments: varied Carnatic instruments beyond traditional Kathakali and Mohiniyattam ensembles
music_profile.musical_form: Concert compositions rendered for dance performances

basic_steps: Adopt tribhanga stance replacing Kathakali's rigid posture
Use angika abhinaya with precise hand gestures
Express emotions through satvika abhinaya (facial expressions)
Dance in solo, duet, or group formations
teaching.formation: Solo, male-female pairs, groups, or extended dance drama ensembles
teaching.level_notes: Beginners start with basic tribhanga posture and simple hand gestures; advanced levels include expressive facial abhinaya and complex group choreography.
